resolutions: Calibrate the sentiment model to output multi-class labels (positive, negative, neutral) with calibrated confidence scores; implement threshold-based routing so low-confidence predictions are escalated for review.

Improve negation, context, and sarcasm handling by adding dependency-parse-based negation scope detection, an enhanced sentiment lexicon for negation/prefix cues, and a dedicated sarcasm detector to be fused with the main sentiment signal.
Enrich training data with diverse domains, languages, and balanced neutral examples; include hard cases (negations, sarcasm, domain-specific jargon) to reduce bias and improve cross-domain accuracy.

Establish monitoring and human-in-the-loop workflows: track per-domain performance and confidence, deploy drift detectors, and route uncertain or high-risk outputs to human reviewers for validation before finalizing labels.
